newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer as NYMEX recovers slightly.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer as NYMEX recovers slightly.

text.p: Brent crude futures were firmer in Asia on Monday, helped by a modest recovery in NYMEX crude values.
February Brent traded late in the session at $23.60 per barrel, up 18 cents from London's settlement on Friday of $23.42. Just 25 lots changed hands.
Brokers said there was little fresh news to push the futures market, although they said Brent had weakened on Friday versus NYMEX, which could prompt some support for the Brent market.
NYMEX crude edged up through the day.
February NYMEX crude, on the after-hours ACCESS system, last traded at $25.24, up two cents from the New York close on Friday.
February had spent most of the day down five or six cents on the New York level, in quiet dealings.
